title: Create the public repository, run setup and create the board
done_when: Everyone has cloned, run setup.sh and sees the board

title: Board views and workflows (browser prompt)
done_when: Views from docs/BOARD.md exist; workflows have no red mark

title: Each person: clone, setup.sh, open their agent
done_when: Every branch exists and every agent answers

title: Ask the Medellín lead the open questions in docs/CHALLENGE.md
done_when: Answers logged in team/bio2/LOG.md and docs/CHALLENGE.md

title: Check docs/CHALLENGE.md against the official page and write the requirements
done_when: Every line of CHALLENGE.md confirmed or corrected; resource list read; requirements written in docs/requirements.md and board/requirements.csv and imported

title: Choose the solution and write FORMATS.md (files, formats, owners)
done_when: FORMATS.md agreed by everyone; architecture choice in docs/DECISIONS.md

title: Break the solution into cards for the rest of the weekend
done_when: Every person has cards for B2 and B3 that fit the block capacity

title: Merge, tag and sync the board at every checkpoint
done_when: cp1, cp2, cp3 and submission tags exist; CHANGELOG has one section each

title: Pitch script (2 minutes)
done_when: submission/script.md read aloud in 2 minutes

title: Seven slides in English
done_when: 7 slides including title, team and members

title: Video script and storyboard (30 s or less, English subtitles)
done_when: Second-by-second script and the list of screens to record, read and timed

title: Submission page text, including the AI-use disclosure
done_when: Every field filled in English

title: Public demo online and checked anonymously
done_when: Links open in a private window without login

title: README with how to run the project
done_when: A stranger can run it from README.md

title: Submit by the internal freeze and rehearse three times
done_when: Submitted by 13:30 (official close 23:59 local); story rehearsed 3 times

title: Record the demo video, add English subtitles and publish it
done_when: Video of 30 s or less with burned-in English subtitles at a public link

title: Home and History use the backend state route
done_when: Each indicator shows the state from GET /people/{id}/indicators/{id}/state (no_data, in_range, outside_range, needs_review); the screen falls back to the local rule with no network; the shared vectors in scripts/fixtures/format_rules/ pass in Vitest

title: Record the context of each reading and prompt the routine measurement
done_when: The entry form has context (rest, after_exercise, on_waking, before_sleep; default rest), sync sends it, demo_data context is read; Home asks for the measurement that fits the moment of the routine (REQ-09 routine prompts)

title: Routine streak without rankings
done_when: Progress shows days in a row with a complete record; it never rewards a value and never compares crew members (REQ-09 gamification)

title: Pick the mission environment
done_when: The crew member picks station, spacecraft, lunar base or Mars base; the header names it; nothing else changes (REQ-09 mission environments)

title: Short state-change animations that respect reduced motion
done_when: State changes animate in under 300 ms; all motion is off under prefers-reduced-motion; the Playwright path still passes (REQ-09 animations, REQ-15)

title: Rate limit on the public API
done_when: Each client address gets at most a set number of requests per minute (env RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE), 429 beyond it, /health exempt; tests; documented in docs/API.md (REQ-14)

title: Condition evidence score route
done_when: GET returns each condition's evidence score from 0 to 1, its label and its signals, per FORMATS.md and F-bio2-02 (side per signal, fewer than 2 usable signals is no data); tests use the vectors in the finding

title: Blood pressure reports the worse of its two states
done_when: The state route returns one blood pressure state, the worse of systolic and diastolic; tests use the F-bio2-01 vectors

title: The state route leaves the tested reading out of its window
done_when: GET .../state takes optional mission_day and time; when given, the window holds only the stored readings before that moment, so a reading the app already posted is not compared with itself; without them it works as now; tests and docs/API.md updated

title: Accounts with a PIN and session tokens in the API
done_when: POST /accounts and POST /sessions per docs/API.md; PIN hashed with scrypt and a salt; HMAC-signed token with SESSION_SECRET; routes of a person with an account need its token (401 without, 403 for another person); people without an account stay open; five wrong PINs lock that account for 10 minutes; memory, SQLite and Supabase stores; schema.sql updated; tests

title: Sign in with face, username and PIN, or the open demo
done_when: Identify phase offers face sign-in first when a face is saved on the device, username and PIN, create account, and an open demo button; the session token is kept per person and sent on every call; a 401 asks for the PIN again; registering a face needs a signed-in person and the face then unlocks that stored session

title: Reaction check screen with light or sound
done_when: Optional step in the report phase: the astronaut picks light or sound, answers each stimulus with a tap or the space bar; random waits; false starts counted; result saved as the two reaction indicators through the outbox; keyboard, touch, reduced motion; tests and e2e

title: Reaction indicators: method, units and sources
done_when: Two rows in config/data/indicators.csv for the median reaction time and the lapses (ids, unit, direction, min_spread, tier, system neuro_behavioural, measured_on_board, hazards, sources), the test length, wait range and lapse cut-off written in a finding with sources (PVT-B), demo rows in demo_ranges.csv and demo_data.csv

title: Current psychological state: thresholds and the condition
done_when: Attention rows for the two reaction indicators (source or Assumption) and one neuro-behavioural condition in config/rules/conditions.csv joining the reaction signals, mood and sleep with their sides; wording rule: the current state today, never a label, a disorder or a diagnosis

title: Texts for the reaction indicators and the state
done_when: config/content/<id>.md for the two reaction indicators with the five questions and every state and level; the state described as how the person is today, never a label

title: State rule: a sourced limit is checked before the baseline
done_when: A reading that crosses an attention row with a source returns needs_review even with no baseline (39.5 C on day 1); an Assumption row never triggers on its own; tests use the phys-02 vectors

title: Reaction check follows phys-06: 3 minutes, 2-5 s wait, lapse at 355 ms
done_when: constants.ts uses a fixed 180000 ms duration, waits of 2000-5000 ms and a lapse at >= 355 ms; a run gives 40-50 trials; tests cover the 355 boundary and the end of time

title: Nutrition indicators: appetite, fluid intake and body mass
done_when: appetite_1_5, fluid_intake_ml and body_mass_kg in indicators.csv with source, min_spread and demo rows (Phys), and their content files (Bio 1); check_content --strict passes

title: Symptoms format: symptoms.csv, symptom_log and an optional symptoms column in conditions.csv
done_when: FORMATS.md defines the two files and the fifth column; check_content accepts four or five columns (old rows stay valid) and checks every symptom id; tests cover both

title: Symptoms count in the condition score
done_when: POST and read of the symptom log; a reported symptom listed in a condition adds evidence like a signal; with no symptoms column the score is unchanged; tests use Bio 2 vectors

title: Report symptoms in the report phase
done_when: The report phase lists the symptoms from symptoms.csv as optional checkboxes, saved through the outbox; hidden when the file is missing

title: Pre-mission profile and labs behind a disclosure
done_when: Static files with the synthetic pre-mission profile and labs (Bio 2), shown read-only behind a disclosure in the status phase (Eng 1); no backend
